GOLD_SEMANTICS_preSourceFix.json.what_it_was: a PERMANENT SIDECAR holding per-reference gold statistics, written by an audit that explicitly declined to touch the builder ('This audit does NOT rewrite integrity_report.json; the corrected fields live here').
GOLD_SEMANTICS_preSourceFix.json.why_superseded: the directive required folding it into the regular integrity outputs. Both builders now compute per-reference gold semantics natively and emit them as integrity_report.json -> GOLD_SEMANTICS, plus top-level ALL_GOLD_REFS_RESOLVE / MISSING_GOLD_REFS / AMBIGUOUS_GOLD_REFS. A sidecar describing a check the builder did not perform is exactly the drift this removes.

2wiki.AMBIGUOUS_GOLD_REFS.reason: the sidecar could only OBSERVE that 8 train refs to the title 'Unconquered' hit 2 candidate nodes. The patched builder RESOLVES them from each question's own official context paragraph: all 8 map uniquely to 2wiki:c8073502 (the 1947 DeMille film); the rival 2wiki:c62717110 is a disambiguation page. Ambiguity that is resolvable from the source is not ambiguity.

GOLD_SEMANTICS_preSourceFix.json.numbers_that_are_UNCHANGED: GOLD_REFS_TOTAL and MISSING_GOLD_REFS for all five datasets, and every CORPUS_HASH (CORPUS_HASH_UNCHANGED was true then and is true now).
